_comment: Worked example: the illustrative 27:40 Kairos detection from the landing page, expressed as a KVU chain per 01-evidence-standard.md. All values are illustrative.

kvus.proposition: Structural shift in match state: control of tempo moved to GEN. Estimated P(GEN win) moved 0.36 -> 0.58.

kvus.falsifier: state reverts (win prob back within ±3pt of pre-event baseline) inside 6:00 of game clock

kvus.authority: cp-gate (automated) under authority: elli (norm N-v: false positives costlier than false negatives, registered 2026-06-30)
